separate_provider.name: LunaRoute
separate_provider.main_workflow: Barrot Sync failed before a verified API call because httpx was missing; workflow masked the failure
separate_provider.secret_echo_correction: The main workflow's echo command cuts the combined fixed banner and secret to 30 characters; the banner itself is exactly 30 characters, so no secret characters are emitted by this command.
separate_provider.integration_workflow: quarantined/disabled; no push trigger; read-only permissions

coordination_rules.independent_tasks: assign only after each platform's authentication and permissions are tested
coordination_rules.evidence_exchange: structured source URL, publisher, event time, retrieval time, excerpt hash, lineage group, claim, counterclaim and confidence
coordination_rules.disagreement_resolution: resolve against primary evidence; preserve minority objections and disconfirming evidence
coordination_rules.red_team: independent reviewer must not be the same identity that authored the change
coordination_rules.least_privilege: minimum read-only scope by default; writes require action-specific authorization
